description: REFERENCE (rom_signature + segments) for Fire Emblem GBA (FE7/FE8). Text is Huffman-compressed, so JSON cannot express it: this config DOCUMENTS the real scan range from gba_fire_emblem.py: FE text area 0x100000-0x400000 (bytes are Huffman-compressed - the ASCII charmap above only applies AFTER decompression). Huffman tree bases (from FEBuilderGBA/community docs): FE7U 0xB808AC, FE8U 0x15D48C. Full extraction requires the Python plugin FireEmblemGBAPlugin (gba_fire_emblem.py) - the JSON config is NOT usable for extraction as-is. Hack authors: copy and adapt title_pattern to match YOUR hack ROM title.
